Trijumf, also known as Croatian Triumph, is a card game popular on the Croatian coast and islands. Although the name is similar to Italian trionfo, the Croatian version is more similar to the Venetian game madrasso, with some elements of marianna.
40 cards (Triestine). Rank: A-3-K-Kt-J-7-6-5-4-2. Values: A=11, 3=10, K=4, Kt=3, J=2. Total 120 + 10 for last trick = 130.
10 cards each. Trump determined by card flip or declaration.
